page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single main column; running head at top; in the right margin, cut-off marginal notes from the facing page (show-through and edge of neighbouring page, not transcribed).

main_text.p: tior, quam naturæ convenit. Huc revocatur actio quæ debitum tempus anticipat; ut in stranguria videre est. Unde nullo negotio actionis læsæ symptomata colliguntur. Ac primùm abolita functio omnium actionum animalium, est apoplexia; abolita cogitatio, est extrema fatuitas; diminuta, stultitia: depravata, delirium. Idem de sensu communi, quò pertinent somnus & vigilia, judicandum est: nam carus, lethargus auferunt omnem vigiliam; diminuitur in comate; in pervigilio depravatur. Idem judicium esto de actionibus sensuum externorum. Ita membri alicuius motus voluntarius abolitus, est paralysis: diminutus, est stupor. depravatus, convulsio. Idem judicium esto functionis vitalis. Facultatis naturalis symptomata sunt multiplicia: singulæ enim partes attrahunt, retinent, concoquunt, expellunt. Vnaquæque harum actionum tribus modis lædi-tur: aut enim est abolita, aut diminuta, aut depravata. Ac proinde huius

page.notes: Right margin carries cut-off fragments of the facing page's notes (e.g. "Iustit", "fas faculta", "quatenus", "publico"), illegible and not transcribed. The footer word "Vnaquaque" was not printed as a note; the catchword-like "huius" at the foot right is the line-end catchword and is given as the last word of the text. The bottom-line fragment "ius" is the catchword. Some words in the margin are uncertain.
